skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-google-ads-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Set up customer lifetime value bidding in Google Ads for a Cloudflare storefront using Product Metrics. Check tracking and choose between revenue and profit signals based on recorded purchases.
skill.summary: Set up and verify Google Ads lifetime value bidding with Cloudflare Tracking and Product Metrics.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The backtick and reconnaissance alerts mostly match Markdown and ordinary setup checks; the unpinned installer does pose a supply chain risk. The workflow also leaves gaps in credential handling, Cloudflare permissions, consent timing, and trust in remote instructions. No evidence was found of malware, deliberate exfiltration, or an attempt to override the audit.

remediation.issue: The installation example runs an unpinned package and points to a mutable skill source.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer to a reviewed version and the skill to an immutable commit. Document how users can verify both before installing.

remediation.issue: Shared rules allow agents to receive and pass unrelated platform credentials to a command.
remediation.suggestion: Remove credential exceptions from this skill. Use the provider's browser authorization or an approved secret store rather than chat or command arguments.

remediation.issue: Cloudflare troubleshooting tells users to approve every permission without explaining the required scopes.
remediation.suggestion: List and justify the required scopes for the selected account and zone. Tell users to stop if the authorization screen requests unexpected access.

remediation.issue: The workflow tests an identified purchase before it verifies consent.
remediation.suggestion: Require a consent check before processing real orders. Use test data and verify that orders without both permissions are not forwarded.

remediation.issue: The test-order lookup can retrieve unrelated order records.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for the test order number and use a scoped lookup. Report receipt and value checks without exposing customer identifiers or unrelated orders.

remediation.issue: The agent can relay URLs returned by tools and follow remote guides without separate checks.
remediation.suggestion: Verify browser destinations against the expected provider domains before relaying them. Prefer local reviewed guides and treat remote content as reference material only.

semantic_findings.title: Out-of-scope credential handling
semantic_findings.description: The shared rules allow the agent to collect Lightspeed, Meta, and OpenAI credentials and pass them to a command. None is needed for this workflow.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception explicitly permits receiving the secrets. Passing them directly to a command can expose them in tool records or process arguments despite instructions not to log them.

semantic_findings.title: Blanket Cloudflare permission approval
semantic_findings.description: The troubleshooting guide says to 'approve every permission' without naming the required scopes. The gateway setup can add tracking to every page of the selected domain.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The blanket approval instruction is explicit. The guide does not show what Cloudflare actually requests, so the review cannot establish that any specific scope is excessive.

semantic_findings.title: Consent verification follows purchase collection
semantic_findings.description: The guide deploys tracking before consent configuration and tests an email-linked purchase before verifying the banner. This can expose purchase data to Product Metrics before consent handling is verified.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The order of operations is explicit, but collection defaults are not documented here. The guide requires both consent signals before forwarding LTV conversions to Google Ads.

semantic_findings.title: Test-order check can retrieve unrelated records
semantic_findings.description: The test-order instructions call for a newest-first order listing without a test order filter. This can bring unrelated customer and financial records into the agent's context.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The list is scoped to a company and storefront but not to the test order. The exact fields returned by the list were not established.

semantic_findings.title: Remote instructions lack independent trust checks
semantic_findings.description: The workflow tells the agent to relay returned browser URLs and substitute live Markdown for bundled guides. It does not require independent destination checks or review of changed instructions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow delegates navigation and guidance to service responses and mutable documents. No evidence shows that the documented service or links are currently compromised.

content.user_title: Set Up Google Ads Lifetime Value Bidding
content.value_statement: A first purchase does not show how much a repeat customer may be worth. Use Product Metrics to set up Google Ads bidding with revenue or profit signals from recorded Cloudflare storefront purchases.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status for the selected workspace and property through the CLI or MCP.
Guide the user through Cloudflare gateway authorization and the Google Ads, Data Manager, and Merchant Center connections.
Guide consent banner configuration and creation of secondary Google Ads conversion actions, including Revenue LTV and Profit LTV.
Explain which cost estimates and fees Profit LTV needs.
Check whether Product Metrics received a test order and read back the Google Ads conversion action status.
limitations: The setup requires Product Metrics Pro, workspace admin access, and a Cloudflare-proxied storefront.
The user completes browser approvals and makes campaign bidding changes in Google Ads.
Storefront tracking does not import earlier orders or predict future spending.
Google Ads LTV conversions require customer recognition, matchable identifiers, and both analytics and ad user data consent. Profit LTV also needs known costs.

use_cases.title: Check Storefront Readiness
use_cases.description: Find which tracking prerequisites are complete and which approvals are needed for a Cloudflare storefront.

use_cases.title: Plan a Revenue LTV Pilot
use_cases.description: Compare purchase-based bidding with Revenue LTV and plan the manual change for one campaign.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Missing Profit Values
use_cases.description: Check whether the product cost fallback or additional fees are missing before relying on Profit LTV.

prompt_templates.title: Check Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: What do I need to use Revenue LTV bidding on a Cloudflare storefront? Only give me a checklist.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Check whether the storefront is eligible.

prompt_templates.title: Review Current Tracking
prompt_templates.prompt: Check tracking for my selected Product Metrics property. Tell me which Cloudflare, Google Ads, and consent steps remain. Do not make changes.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Test Order
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the test order number I provide in the selected storefront. Report whether it arrived and whether profit is available. Omit customer identifiers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Verify order collection before changing a campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Profit LTV Pilot
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Profit LTV readiness for one campaign. List the required cost checks, manual conversion goal changes, and target ROAS considerations. Leave the campaign unchanged.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Prepare a change for the campaign owner to review.

output_examples.input: Is my storefront ready for LTV tracking?
output: Cloudflare Tracking is connected to the selected property.
Google Ads is linked, but Data Manager access still needs your approval.
Verify the consent banner before placing a test order.

output_examples.input: Why does my test order show revenue but no profit?
output: Product Metrics received the test order and recorded its revenue.
Product Metrics cannot report Profit LTV until the order costs are known.
Check the product cost fallback and additional costs under Profit tracking.

output_examples.input: What should I change for a Revenue LTV pilot?
output: Revenue LTV is present as a secondary conversion action. No campaign settings changed.
For the pilot campaign, use Revenue LTV as the only purchase action for bidding.
Choose a target ROAS based on the new conversion values rather than copying the old target.

best_practices: Confirm the storefront, Product Metrics property, and Google Ads client account before making changes.
Verify consent and check a test order while the LTV actions are still secondary.
Start with one campaign and keep one primary purchase action for its bidding goal.
anti_patterns: Making Revenue LTV and Profit LTV primary for the same campaign.
Reusing a purchase-based target ROAS without checking how LTV changes the conversion values.
Pasting passwords, tokens, or API keys into chat to complete an account connection.

faq.question: Do I need a store plugin?
faq.answer: No. The workflow uses Cloudflare Tracking and requires a proxied storefront domain, a Product Metrics property, and browser authorization.

faq.question: Which Google accounts must be connected?
faq.answer: Connect the Google Ads client account that runs the campaigns, not its manager account. Link Merchant Center and grant Data Manager access.

faq.question: Does LTV include orders from before setup?
faq.answer: Not through storefront tracking. It starts with the first order Product Metrics receives. A separate backend integration can supply earlier orders.

faq.question: Does each purchase send the full lifetime value?
faq.answer: No. An eligible conversion reports what that purchase adds to lifetime value. The sum reflects recorded activity, not a prediction.

faq.question: What does Profit LTV need?
faq.answer: Website orders do not include product costs. Configure the product cost fallback and additional costs, such as shipping and payment fees.

faq.question: Can the assistant switch my campaign to LTV bidding?
faq.answer: No. You choose the bidding goal and target ROAS in Google Ads. The assistant can guide you and then check the conversion action status.
